steps: Press GLOBALS once (top row), press program button 2 (MIDI Channel) and pick the channel with the Group/Bank buttons.
Press program button 6 (MIDI SysEx) and choose the port you're plugged into: Mdi for the 5-pin sockets, USB for USB.
Press 3 (Param Xmit) and set NRn, then 4 (Param Rcv) and set NRn, so knob moves travel as NRPN.
Press 7 (MIDI Out) and pick the same port (or ALL), then press GLOBALS to exit.
Don't use the front-panel program dump to share: it writes into a stored slot. The app asks for the current sound instead.
